10-08-1871 is October 8, 1871.  
Add 262 days:  
October has 31 days → remaining days in October = 31 - 8 = 23 → 262 - 23 = 239 left.  
November (30) → 239 - 30 = 209 left.  
December (31) → 209 - 31 = 178 left.  
1872 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1872 divisible by 4, not by 100 → leap).  
January (31) → 178 - 31 = 147 left.  
February (29) → 147 - 29 = 118 left.  
March (31) → 118 - 31 = 87 left.  
April (30) → 87 - 30 = 57 left.  
May (31) → 57 - 31 = 26 left.  
June 26, 1872.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1872-06-26
